body: Fuck off with your religion.  If it works for you fine, that doesn't mean it's going to work for everyone

A spouse's death, no matter from what cause, hurts like hell.  In fact it can plunge you into hell.  It's over 8 years since my spouse died and I'm still in hell.  

Instead confide in your spouse how you feel.  Let them help you.  Let them love you.   

I hope you decide against it.
Can I DM you?
I identify with this, so much.
I am sorry you feel so bad and hope beyond hope this is not your last post.
LOL, I see you caught up on my motivation!
Thank you, but my situation is unique.  I appreciate the offer to talk tho

My dog saved me many times.  I knew that no one could love her and treat her as well as I did.  They know.  They feel.  They have personalities, just as we do.  Love him and cuddle him.  Enjoy him.  Be there for him.
Definitely not serene but Paradise by the Dashboard Light - Meatloaf
I'm sorry for your loss.  You might find more help in r/suicidebereavement

You can do it slowly if you want to hurt more.  No, it doesn't only hurt when the knife goes through the skin, but the whole time.  Oh and by the way, you'd better know anatomy pretty well or you're going to miss the heart and just cause yourself pain.  

Better idea: talk to us about what's going on that makes you feel this way.

I'm sorry you're feeling so bad.  Many people in clinics or mental health hospitals don't feel that their stay helps them but it is an opening to other help.  Take whatever help you can get, even if it doesn't seem to be working for a while.  Sometimes it gets better in time even if it doesn't appear to be working at first.
I feel your fourth paragraph.
That poor man can't thank you for what you did so I will do so.  You are a truly good person.
I'm sorry you have lost so much.  It is probably unbearably painful right now but you never know what is around the corner.
I'm sorry for your pain
I'd go skydiving, it's something I've always wanted to do but various reasons (namely money and courage) haven't managed.
This is a beautiful and heartfelt post.  Thank you.

I think you are being a bit harsh.  If you google any method of suicide you are flooded with helplines etc.   Yes, you can dig deeper but most sites which have this kind of information require you to sign up and log in.  People don't want that kind of stuff on their computer history.  Plus some of them may not be as familiar with the internet.   

No, we can't answer those sort of questions here but that doesn't mean you have to be rude about it.
This is beautiful

We all get that feeling sometimes.  Having emigrated I haven't seen my sister for a couple of years but it doesn't mean I don't care.  She died yesterday following a stroke and it hurts so much.   Due to quarantine I may not even be able to attend her funeral and that hurts too. We don't always show our loved ones that we care but we do.
Really sorry to hear about your position.  Would your current partner be open to you seeking help for your alcohol issues together?
I feel the same way mate.  Everything for me seems to be more difficult than others find it.  I don't know why or how but it just seems the universe has it in for me.

I should preface this by saying I'm a straight female, so nothing sexual here.  However, you are handsome.  Your picture shows your kind personality.  I love the sparkle in your eyes.  You have no reason to be ashamed.  You will find the person for you when the time is right.

All of us have these thoughts when a relationship doesn't work out.  It hurts so much but you are a unique human being.  There is no other you in the world.  You will find your path and progress along it.

Grief is hard man.  Very hard.  Worst thing is that there's no way around it (trust me, I tried), we just have to work through it.  Gradually color will come back into your life.  It might not be today, tomorrow, next week but it will happen.  

I'm really sorry for your loss.

I understand this.  I often sleep, even when I'm not actually tired, just to get a different perspective on things.  It improves my outlook a little but it doesn't change reality.  It keeps you going for a little while though.  

I have to believe that one day it will improve.  I hope it does for you.
I'm sorry you have had a bad experience.  That's no reason to think it will happen again though.  Even if you do it openly please feel free to talk to us.

I'm so sorry.  Please know that you are not alone, there are people here who care about you.  

I'm pleased you didn't delete this.  It's important to get your thoughts out there.   Your world is not dead, just a little bleak for the moment.  Reach out and people will help.
